newsitem.title: CHINA: Death penalty for China farmer for killing 13 women.
newsitem.headline: Death penalty for China farmer for killing 13 women.

text.p: A Chinese court has sentenced a farmer to death for killing, raping and robbing 13 women, the Yangcheng Evening News said in an edition seen in Beijing on Tuesday.
The Intermediate People's Court in the southern city of Guangzhou convicted Li Wenxiang of murder, rape and robbery on Monday, the newspaper said. He can appeal to the Higher People's Court.
Li, 44, stabbed or strangled the 13 women in Guangzhou's suburbs between April 1992 and November 1996, the newspaper said.
